correctness.rationale: Let z=e^t and h^2=z-1/4. Equal scaling of the two subedges of every original side forces the three old-vertex factors in the barycentric subdivision to coincide. The midpoint factors are therefore t-c,t-c,-c. Comparing the centroid-to-m12 and centroid-to-m23 equations requires t=2 log(R12/R23). Exact coordinates give (R12/R23)^2=(z+2)/(4z-1), so equality is equivalent to (2z+1)(z-1)=0. In the nondegenerate range z>1/4, only z=1 is possible. The converse at t=0 is immediate.
